_comment: Animated (Lottie) tile symbols, downloaded by the owner with their IconScout subscription into art/source/animated-symbols/ (gitignored; tools never download from IconScout). `python3 tool/assets/prepare_animated.py` validates + minifies each sourceFile into content/brain-train/animated-symbols/<outputFile>; `dart run tool/content.dart build` adds them to the registry as `lottie` symbols and gives ~20% of each level's pairs to them. Order matters: levels take the next unused symbols in this order (level 1 the first 2, level 2 the next 3, ...), so emoji, Valentine and dog items alternate and look-alikes are kept apart. Codes and outputFile names are published and immutable. Only entries with "status": "integrated" go into the registry; "rejected" ones (reason in `rejected`) are kept as a record so they are not downloaded again. `restyle` (prepare_animated.py) thickens, recolours and zooms thin line-art loaders so they read on a 31 px tile; it writes a new outputFile, never over a published one.

packs.title: Dog Playing Tennis Ball Animation Pack

licenseNote: Premium IconScout packs under the owner's subscription license; no attribution required. Keep the original JSON files out of git (art/source/ is gitignored). LF_ entries: LottieFiles free animations the owner downloaded, under the Lottie Simple License (https://lottiefiles.com/page/license); each records `license` and its `sourceUrl` or downloaded `originalFile`.
